WITH target_game AS (
    SELECT game_id, started_at, ended_at, max_players, winner_player, total_turns
    FROM games
    WHERE
        ({{ $json["game_id"] ? "game_id = '" + $json["game_id"] + "'" : "true" }})
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tg.game_id,
    tg.started_at,
    tg.ended_at,
    tg.max_players,
    tg.winner_player,
    tg.total_turns,
    ev.ts,
    ev.player_id,
    ev.player_name,
    ev.event_type,
    ev.card,
    ev.extra,
    '{{ $json.body.question }}' AS question   -- 👈 columna constante con la pregunta
FROM target_game tg
LEFT JOIN game_events ev
    ON ev.game_id = tg.game_id
ORDER BY ev.ts ASC;
